Name: Serendipity Rewards - The Universal Update
Author: JavCombita
Description:
🍀 SERENDIPITY REWARDS

[i]Turn your daily routine into a treasure hunt.[/i]
[line]
💎 What does this mod do?
[b]Serendipity Rewards[/b] injects a rush of dopamine into your farm life. Every time you perform a basic action, there is a configurable chance to trigger a [b]Lucky Event[/b].
[list]
[*][b]🚜 Farming:[/b] Get [b]Double Harvests[/b], discover random [b]Seeds[/b], or find wild [b]Flowers[/b].
[*][b]⛏️ Mining:[/b] Trigger [b]"Ore Duplication"[/b] (massive drops from a single node) or find hidden [b]Gems[/b] inside regular stones.
[*][b]🪓 Forestry:[/b] Experience [b]"Woodsplosions"[/b] (bursts of extra wood) and shake [b]Seasonal Fruits[/b] out of non-fruit trees.
[*][b]🦴 Digging:[/b] Use your Hoe to unearth [b]Artifacts[/b], [b]Treasures[/b], and extra resources.
[*][b]💰 Gold:[/b] Find stashes of coins (100g - 500g) doing [i]anything[/i].
[/list][line]
🌍 The "Universal" Engine (v2.0)
Unlike other mods, Serendipity Rewards doesn't use a fixed list of items. It [b]scans your installed mods[/b] (like [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i], [i]Ridgeside Village[/i], etc.) and automatically adds their crops, fruits, and gems to the reward pool!
[quote][i]Did you install a mod that adds "Moonlight Berries"? You might find them while chopping trees![/i][/quote][line]
⚙️ Fully Configurable
Includes full integration with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]. You can adjust every probability in-game:
[list]
[*][i]Want a balanced game?[/i] Set chances to 5%.
[*][i]Want a cheat mod?[/i] Set chances to 100%.
[*][i]Hate finding seeds?[/i] Set Seed Chance to 0%.
[/list][line]
📱 Compatibility
[list]
[*][b]PC:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+ (Perfect performance).
[*][b]Android:[/b] Fully compatible (SMAPI). Engineered with safety checks to prevent crashes on mobile.
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Works perfectly (Personal luck applies to each player).
[/list][line]
--- Developed with ❤️ by JavCombita
--- Architecture: Harmony + Reflection for maximum cross-platform stability.
